newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dell posts Q1 gains in European markets.
newsitem.headline: Dell posts Q1 gains in European markets.

text.p: PC maker Dell Computer Corp said on Thursday it saw sizeable first-quarter market share gains in Britain, France and Germany as its share of European PC sales climbed 2.2 percentage points to 5.8 percent.

The company, which earlier this week reported first-quarter European sales rose 38 percent to $644 million, declined to break out those results further, but provided market research figures that it said were "pretty accurate."
In unit sales, Dell became the second largest PC supplier in Britain, as its share climbed to 12.8 percent, according to International Data Corp. (IDC).
In France, Dell's share reached 5.4 percent, compared to 3.5 percent a year ago. In Germany, its share was 3.3 percent, up from 2.6 percent, according to IDC.

"Everything is going our way," Hans-Juergen Mammitzsch, managing director of Dell Computer GmbH, told Reuters after a news conference. "We are in a good position to see growth in Europe the rest of the year."

Dell's firstquarter share in the Netherlands increased to 5.0 percent from 3.5 percent, in Sweden to 7.8 percent from 6.3 percent and in Norway to 6.5 percent from 5.0 percent, IDC figures showed. Its share in Switzerland slipped to 4.0 percent from 4.1 percent.
